definition: ISO calendar week label (Monday start)
caveats: W39 is a partial week (HEAD 2026-09-24 is a Thursday).

definition: Monday date of the ISO week
All non-merge commits on main authored that week
derivation: count of commits grouped by author-date ISO week
missingness: weeks W12-W13 = 0 (dormant, retained as 0 not missing)
caveats: main branch only; excludes merge commits (few).

definition: Commits classified agent-authored (Co-Authored-By Claude OR Commit-of trailer, not an automation prefix)
caveats: Undercounts late-period agent work: after ~W32 agent commits are collapsed into merge-train squash commits classified 'automation'. See A provenance note.

definition: Commits with an automation subject prefix (merge-train squash / sentinel / tombstone / chore(worktree) / quiesce)
caveats: merge-train squashes INTEGRATE agent work; rises sharply from W32 when merge-train became the dominant landing mechanism.

definition: Commits with no agent trailer and no automation prefix
caveats: EXPLICIT unknown bucket. NOT claimed to be human: early-history agent commits predating the trailer convention fall here. Do not read as human-authored.

definition: Sum of files-changed across the week's commits
caveats: A file changed in K commits counts K times (NOT unique files). Includes vendored/generated files (node_modules, lockfiles).

definition: Sum of inserted lines across the week's commits
caveats: Raw diff churn incl. vendored/generated/snapshot files; NOT source-only LoC. Large single weeks (e.g. W14) reflect bulk imports.

definition: Sum of deleted lines across the week's commits
insertions + deletions
caveats: Raw churn; matches the book's engineering-line-churn family (not source-tree LoC).

definition: insertions - deletions
caveats: Net can be negative during consolidation weeks (e.g. the 300k->200k retyping).

definition: Commits that touched >=1 file
derivation: count of commits with a shortstat line

definition: Distinct agent worktrees landed via merge-train squash
caveats: = 0 before W32 because merge-train squash was not the landing mechanism yet (agent work landed via direct cherry-pick). LOWER bound on total agent work-units across the whole period.

definition: Distinct agent-ids in that week's merge-train squashes
caveats: Equals agent_landings_merge_train (one squash per agent). Same coverage caveat.

definition: Agent 'register' events in the shared registry
derivation: count event_type==register by event_ts ISO week
caveats: PARTIAL: registry began 2026-05-30 and only 358 register events total; undercounts launches (not every dispatch emits register). Retained missing pre-W22.

definition: Distinct Epic slugs first added under docs/epics/ that week
derivation: first-add date of each epic main.md / <slug>.md
caveats: 1368 distinct slugs ever created (some later renamed/merged/deleted; current on-disk = 814 active + 476 closed). Proxy for engineering-intent units.

definition: Distinct Epic slugs first appearing under docs/epics/closed/ that week
caveats: 479 closed slugs. epic_close.py moves the file into closed/. A move may register as add-in-closed.

definition: Cumulative epics_created
Cumulative epics_closed
cum_epics_created - cum_epics_closed
caveats: Rough: ignores epics deleted without a formal close. Upper-biased vs the ~814 current on-disk active.

definition: Commits whose subject matches deploy/release/version-bump patterns
caveats: LOWER bound: deploys run agentically and may not always produce a distinctly-named tracked commit. Keyword proxy only.
